competencies.text: Design, construct, and test a simple or compound machine.
Apply torque, angular motion, and radius to improve machine efficiency.

days.title: Simple & Compound Machines
days.content:
🎯 Learning Target

By the end of today's lesson, you will be able to identify the six simple machines, explain how they multiply force or change its direction, and describe how compound machines combine them for greater efficiency.

🔧 What Is a Machine?

A machine is any device that makes work easier by:

  • Multiplying force — you push with less effort to move a bigger load.
  • Changing direction — you pull down to lift something up.
  • Increasing speed or distance — you move a small distance to move a load a larger distance.

Machines do not create energy. They simply redirect or multiply the force you apply. The total work is always the same (or slightly more due to friction) — this is called the Law of Conservation of Energy.

⚙️ The Six Simple Machines

Simple MachineWhat It DoesEveryday Example
LeverMultiplies force using a fulcrum; a small effort moves a large loadCrowbar, seesaw, wheelbarrow, scissors
Wheel & AxleReduces friction; a large wheel turns a small axle to multiply forceDoorknob, bicycle wheel, steering wheel
PulleyChanges the direction of force; multiple pulleys reduce effortFlagpole rope, crane, elevator
Inclined PlaneReduces effort by spreading work over a longer distanceRamp, slide, road up a hill
WedgeSplits or separates objects by concentrating force on a small areaKnife, axe, nail, chisel
ScrewConverts rotational force into forward motion; holds things togetherBolt, jar lid, screw, drill bit

🔗 Compound Machines

A compound machine combines two or more simple machines to work together. This makes it more powerful or more versatile.

  • Bicycle: Wheels & axles + levers (brakes) + pulleys (chain drive) + screws (fasteners).
  • Scissors: Two levers + a wedge (the blades).
  • Wheelbarrow: A lever + a wheel & axle.
  • Can opener: Lever + wheel & axle + wedge.

📐 Mechanical Advantage (MA)

Machines are rated by how much they multiply your force — this is called Mechanical Advantage.

MA = Output Force ÷ Input Force

An MA greater than 1 means the machine multiplies your force. A machine with MA = 4 lets you lift 4× the load you could otherwise.

💡 Real-Life Application

Filipino tricycle drivers use compound machines every day: levers (brake handles, gear shifter), wheels & axles (the tricycle's wheels), pulleys (the chain drive on some models), and screws (every bolt on the vehicle). Understanding machines helps you use them safely and maintain them longer.

📌 Quick Check

  • Which simple machine is a broom? (Answer: lever)
  • Which simple machine is a ramp? (Answer: inclined plane)
  • Why is a bicycle considered a compound machine? (Answer: it combines several simple machines)

days.title: Match Game — Machine Types
days.content:
🔗 Activity 1 — Match the Pairs

Match each simple machine or machine concept to the correct example or definition. There are 8 pairs and unlimited retakes to reach 75%.

Tip: Think about the type of motion each machine produces — pushing, pulling, lifting, turning, or splitting.

match.right: Doorknob turning to open a door
Flag being raised on a flagpole
Ramp for loading goods into a truck
Bicycle combining wheels, levers, and pulleys

days.title: Scenario Challenge — Torque & Efficiency
days.content:
🎯 Activity 2 — Scenario Challenge

Read each scenario and choose the best physics-based reasoning. There are 5 scenarios. You have unlimited retakes to reach 75%.

scenario.text: 🔧 A mechanic uses a longer wrench to loosen a very tight bolt. Why does the longer wrench work better than a shorter one?

choices.label: A) The longer wrench is heavier.
B) The longer wrench increases torque by increasing the lever arm distance from the pivot.
C) The longer wrench has more friction.
D) The longer wrench uses gravity better.

scenario.text: 🏗️ A construction worker uses a pulley system with 3 pulleys to lift heavy cement bags. What is the main advantage of using multiple pulleys?

choices.label: A) It makes the bag lighter.
B) It reduces the effort force needed by distributing the load across multiple rope segments.
D) It converts energy into mass.

scenario.text: 🚲 A bicycle's pedal gear has 40 teeth, and the rear gear has 20 teeth. When you pedal once, how many times does the rear wheel turn?
🪓 Which simple machine is a knife blade, and how does it make cutting easier?

choices.label: A) Lever — it multiplies force by using a pivot.
B) Wedge — it concentrates force on a small area to split material.
C) Screw — it converts rotational force into forward motion.
D) Inclined plane — it spreads work over distance.

scenario.text: ⚙️ In a wheelbarrow, where is the fulcrum located?

choices.label: A) At the handles where you lift
B) At the wheel (the pivot point)
C) In the middle of the load

days.title: Formative Check — Escape the Machine Shop
days.content:
🔐 Formative Check — Escape the Machine Shop

You have 3 lives and 6 keys to unlock. You need 75% (5 of 6) to pass. Take your time — read every option carefully.

escape.text: Which of the following is NOT one of the six simple machines?
A machine has an output force of 200 N and an input force of 50 N. What is its Mechanical Advantage?
Which simple machine changes the DIRECTION of the applied force?
Why is a pair of scissors considered a compound machine?

choices.label: A) Because it is made of metal.
B) Because it combines two levers and two wedges (blades).
D) Because it has moving gears.

escape.text: Which of the following correctly describes a screw?

choices.label: A) A lever that pivots on a fulcrum
B) An inclined plane wrapped around a cylinder
C) A wheel with a groove for a rope
D) A flat surface at an angle
